verdict.rationale: The client documents batch operations directly. `run_tasks_until_done()` runs multiple tasks and waits for them all to complete, and the platform API supports submitting many jobs and querying their results later through async create/get methods. A whole directory can also be uploaded as a collection in one call. missing for 10: bulk operations beyond task submission and upload (e.g., bulk cancel, delete or retrieve), documented batch size and limit details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
